title: Invertibility of the counit-defined affine-space coefficient mate
statement: Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and $1\le m\le n$. Set $A=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi^n)$, $B=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi^m)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. For a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $Y$ [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], write $a_Y:Y\to s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $F_{Y,R}=Ra_{Y,R!}\dashv G_{Y,R}=a_{Y,R}^{\times}$, $\omega_{Y,R}=G_{Y,R}R_s$, and $\varepsilon_{Y,R}:F_{Y,R}\omega_{Y,R}\to R_s$, for $R=A,B$, on ordinary small etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-amb-etale-compact-support, thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. Let $T_Y=-\otimes_A^LB$ [def-kun-derived-tensor], and denote the canonical compact-support coefficient comparison by $c_{Y,K}:T_sF_{Y,A}K\to F_{Y,B}T_YK$ [lem-fix-compact-support-coefficient-change]. Here bounded constructible finite-Tor means constructible cohomology, zero outside a finite interval, and integers $a\le b$ such that tensoring with every degree-zero module sheaf has cohomology only in $[a,b]$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Assume the named dualizing objects are bounded constructible of finite Tor amplitude. Define $u_Y:T_Y\omega_{Y,A}\to\omega_{Y,B}$ to be the unique map with $\varepsilon_{Y,B}F_{Y,B}(u_Y)=(T_s\varepsilon_{Y,A})c_{Y,\omega_{Y,A}}^{-1}$, using $T_sA_s\cong B_s$. Let $r\ge0$ and $P=\mathbf A^r_k$. Give $R_P(r)$ the ordinary etale Tate twist: choose a power $N$ of $\ell$ annihilating $A$, set $R_P(1)=\mu_{N,P}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/N}R_P$, and take its $r$th tensor power [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. With the counit-compatible identifications $\omega_{P,R}\cong R_P(r)[2r]$ from the affine-space adjunction [cor-amb-affine-space-adjunction], the map $u_P$ is an isomorphism. In particular its source is identified with $B_P(r)[2r]$ by the rank-one tensor comparison $T_P(A_P(r)[2r])\cong B_P(r)[2r]$, and $\varepsilon_{P,R}$ is an isomorphism for the chosen adjoint, with the explicit coordinate-tower counit normalization [lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace]. For $r=0$ the counit-defined comparison is $1_{B_s}$ under the identity-adjunction identifications.

proof.text: The two finite coefficient rings are annihilated by the common positive power l^n, which is a unit on Spec k because l differs from the characteristic. Take the existing normalized coordinate-trace data. Transport their counits along the ordered left-functor comparison by uniqueness of right adjoints; counit naturality through the single/unit isomorphism proves precisely AffineDualizingTraceNormalization. The existing canonical CoordinateCounitArrows.towerTateIso directly identifies each tower object with its shifted ordinary Tate power.

The degree-zero constant unit, hence the derived tensor unit, is constructible of finite Tor amplitude. Apply the general finite-ring ordinaryAffineProjectionAssertion proved in the module of lem-pur-etale-affine-projection-coefficient-mate, with base Spec k and input the tensor unit. Its actual mate is invertible; composing with the exceptional right adjoint applied to the coefficient-unit isomorphism proves invertibility of the specified dualizing scalar map. The existing exceptional tensor-unit counit evaluation, cancellation of the compact-support isomorphism and the adjunction Hom equivalence give the displayed counit equation and its uniqueness. Ordinary-etale compact-support coefficient coherence gives the compact-support clause.

Use finite_tate_scalar_source_normalization at the affine tower. Its generator balancing in powers zero and one is exactly the two required adjoint generator equations (put b=1). Its ordinary tensor-power recursion is the remaining normalization equation. The normalized shifted line map is definitionally the specified affineDualizingShiftedSingleMap, so its IsIso clause supplies the shifted single comparison.

In dimension zero, the ordered trace adjunction is literally the identity. The identity-tail coherence for the unbounded compact-support comparison, together with naturality of the derived direct-image identity isomorphism, shows that reductionEtaleAffineLeftIso is the inverse of unboundedEtaleLowerShriekId. Uniqueness of right adjoints identifies affineProjectionPurityIso with the inverse of the zero-coordinate isomorphism. The normalized projection mate equation in dimension zero now reads Q(e_A.inv) followed by the mate equals e_B.inv. Naturality with the coefficient-unit isomorphism and inverse cancellation yield the literal identity required in the final clause.
